## Capability

Content an activity delivers, sized so a batch of them can be read against a budget.

## Outputs

### preparation_note

What the step recorded, so the activity has something to report.

## Protocol

### 1. Record

- Write a short note under `{preparation_note}` describing what this stop did.
- The note is the whole of the work: this technique exists to give an activity a body to deliver,
  so a walk measuring delivery has something to measure.

## Rules

### one-note-per-stop

Each stop records its own note rather than appending to an earlier one, so two stops never look
like one.
